_notes: 15 raw answers (1-4) per fixture, in question order 1-15.
Question-to-cluster mapping (from the live HTML, confirmed correct):
Winner = highest cluster total. On an exact tie, the LATER key wins
(confirmed via the live code's reduce() semantics, not the earlier key
as originally assumed) — iteration order is connector, cultivator,
Tier = high if winner's score >= 20, mid if >= 12, else low.
Overall = sum of all 15 raw answers (informational only, not a gate).

fixtures.name: cultivator_high
fixtures.description: Single-cluster signal: all cultivator questions maxed, everything else minimal.

fixtures.name: connector_mid
fixtures.description: Connector's shared questions raised; everything else kept low.

fixtures.name: opportunity_seeker_low
fixtures.description: Opportunity Seeker wins but stays under the mid-tier threshold.

fixtures.name: community_builder_mid
fixtures.description: Community Builder wins comfortably inside the mid band.

fixtures.name: mixed_realistic
fixtures.description: Real ground truth: first 9 answers = Occasionally (2), last 6 = Frequently (3). Verified live at tools.werkitgirls.com on 2026-09-27 (slow retake) and confirmed to match these formulas exactly.

fixtures.name: boundary_high_exact
fixtures.description: Edge case: winner's score lands exactly on 20, the mid/high tier threshold. Must trigger high, not mid.

fixtures.name: boundary_mid_exact
fixtures.description: Edge case: winner's score lands exactly on 12, the low/mid threshold. Must trigger mid, not low.

fixtures.name: tie_connector_cultivator
fixtures.description: Edge case: Connector and Cultivator land on the exact same total (16). Per the corrected tie-break rule, the LATER key (cultivator) must win, not connector.

fixtures.name: all_ones_four_way_tie
fixtures.description: Edge case: every answer is 1, so all four styles total 6. A four-way tie must go to the last style in the order, communityBuilder. Winner total 6 is below 12, so tier is low.

fixtures.name: all_fours_maximum
fixtures.description: Edge case: every answer is 4, the maximum. All four styles total 24 and overall is 60. The four-way tie goes to communityBuilder, and tier is high.
